verdict.rationale: Dagster's asset checks can verify that a tabular asset adheres to a specified schema. Severity levels and UI-surfaced results give some control over how a detected mismatch is treated, so schema drift need not break loads silently. dbt column lineage adds visibility into which downstream columns are affected. However, the evidence shows only detection; nothing shows Dagster propagating or evolving schema changes downstream under a selectable policy such as evolve, fail, or ignore. Missing for 10: a documented schema-change propagation/evolution policy mechanism, automatic upstream schema-change detection (beyond user-written checks), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
